findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "p_omie" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: omie_get_invoice_xml · Private data: omie_list_document_types, connect, marketplace, authenticate · Public sink: omie_create_customer, omie_update_customer, omie_upload_attachment, report_bug · Destructive: omie_delete_payable, omie_delete_receivable, omie_delete_checking_account_entry, omie_upload_attachment, omie_delete_attachment, marketplace.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: omie_get_invoice_xml · Private data: omie_list_document_types, connect, marketplace, authenticate · Public sink: omie_create_customer, omie_update_customer, omie_upload_attachment, report_bug · Destructive: omie_delete_payable, omie_delete_receivable, omie_delete_checking_account_entry, omie_upload_attachment, omie_delete_attachment, marketplace

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
